info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Operation Order Allocation-spec
info.description: The Market Operation Order Allocation API enables businesses to allocate orders within market operations efficiently. This endpoint allows users to submit new order allocation requests that optimize resource distribution based on market conditions and operational requirements. Typical consumers include financial institutions and trading platforms looking to manage their order flows effectively. By leveraging this API, developers can automate order processing, ensuring timely execution and improved operational agility.

post.summary: Allocate an order to a specific market operation.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to allocate an order to the designated market operation. It ensures that the order is processed appropriately and associated with the correct market context, optimizing operations and resource management.
